voice.name: en-GB-SoniaNeural
voice.prosody: Look up: above the forest, a monastery is clinging to the face of the cliff. The path climbs through pine and beech. Below you, the sound of the Altındere stream; above you, mist. At one bend the trees open and there it is: a monastery built on a sheer rock face, hanging over empty air. Legend says two monks came from Athens at the end of the fourth century. They said they had found an icon of the Virgin Mary in a cave on this cliff, and they settled here. The monastery grew into the rock over the centuries. In the courtyard you face the church carved into the rock. Its walls are covered in frescoes: saints, angels, scenes from the Bible. In the light from above, the colours glow and fade. Look closely at the walls. Some frescoes are painted two or three layers deep. Each generation of painters added its prayer on top of the last. Before you leave, lean on the railing and look down the valley. Mist rises slowly through the trees. Stand still for a few minutes and see what the monks saw every morning.
